class.name: NetwInterestDecl
class.brief_description: What one entity declares about its own interest: the layers it names, and its per-layer overrides.
class.description: An override always resolves before the layer default a caller passes in, and a layer with no override resolves to that default, so a reader never has to merge the two books. CUSTOM is the only policy carrying a callback and the only one that may. A CUSTOM without one resolves to a call that cannot be made, and a callback under any other policy is never reached, so both are refused at declaration time rather than discovered at the edge that needed them. [codeblock] join / leave the layers this entity names set_leave_policy what a layer's departure does on the wire set_perception_policy what it does to what the local player sees leave_policy_for(id, x) the override, else x [/codeblock] Policies are the ordinals of [code]NetwMultiplayer.LeavePolicy[/code] and [code]NetwMultiplayer.PerceptionPolicy[/code], which stay the one published spelling. Nothing here publishes a second.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every label, override and callback, and stops reporting observers.

method.name: custom_leave_for
method.description: The callback declared with a CUSTOM leave policy for [param layer_id], or an empty [Callable]. Only a CUSTOM layer can have one, so an empty answer here and a non-CUSTOM answer from [method leave_policy_for] always agree.

method.name: custom_perception_for
method.description: The callback declared with a CUSTOM perception policy for [param layer_id], or an empty [Callable].

method.name: join
method.description: Names [param layer_id] as a layer this entity belongs to, and answers whether it is new. An empty id is refused.

method.name: labels
method.description: The layer names, in declaration order.

method.name: leave
method.description: Drops [param layer_id] from the names, and answers whether it was there. The overrides declared for it stay, so re-joining resolves the way it did before.

method.name: leave_policy_for
method.description: The leave policy declared for [param layer_id], or [param fallback] when none is. The caller owns the fallback because the layer's own default is what it is, and this record has never heard of it.

method.name: perception_policy_for
method.description: The perception policy declared for [param layer_id], or [param fallback] when none is.

method.name: set_leave_policy
method.description: Declares what [param layer_id]'s departure does to this entity on the wire, and answers whether the declaration was accepted. An empty id, a policy outside the enum, a CUSTOM with no [param custom], and a [param custom] under any other policy are each refused and change nothing.

method.name: set_perception_policy
method.description: Declares what [param layer_id]'s departure does to what the local player sees, under the same four refusals as [method set_leave_policy].

members.member: Whether the server should carry observer-awareness events for this entity. Off until something asks to hear them, because carrying them costs a reliable message per edge.
